title: Typed Payload
prompt: Define a TypedDict ProductDict with keys sku: str and price: float. Then implement total_price(items: list[ProductDict]) -> float summing prices. get_type_hints(ProductDict) must show both annotations.

tests.name: typed keys verified
tests.code:
import typing
hints = typing.get_type_hints(ProductDict)
assert hints['sku'] is str and hints['price'] is float
tests.hint: Annotate sku: str and price: float in the TypedDict body.
